nodes.title: Stack voice samples rendered on staging 69597eb through the product's own adapters (python -m vpvoice.samples): 6 of 7 curated stacks from 3 clips, all passing QA and shipped in product/web/public/samples. gemini-lite~Despina 5.90 s, 36.0 KB, -16.8 LUFS (v2-flashlite, v2-54mini, v2-38flash, v2-luna); gemini-3.8-live~Despina 5.53 s, 33.5 KB, -15.9 LUFS (v2-live); azure-mai~Kavya 8.45 s, 49.2 KB, -16.5 LUFS (v2-mai). Ogg/Opus mono 48 kHz. Azure Speech hi-IN heard the line in 3/3: word errors 0, 0 and 2 of 17 (one spacing variant), CER 0 with AI=एआई; the disclosure 3/3 (safety.affirms_ai) and 'आशा' 3/3 (0 name repairs). sarvam-india not rendered (no Sarvam key on staging). Web's parseSamples accepts 6/6 and every URL resolves in dist. About Rs 1.0 (list prices)
nodes.method: 2026-10-24 04:04 UTC, VM vl-vm-cin, staging redeployed to 69597eb first (vps5-deploy-69597eb: deploy_pre + stage_setup verbatim + deploy_post; 3 new migrations). ffmpeg was absent on the VM and was installed from the Ubuntu archive (only the renderer, its tests and benches use it); the offline renderer tests then passed with ffmpeg (0 skipped) before any request. Render as vpstage from the staging tree with staging's env minus NODE_ENV (the renderer refuses production; this one process only) and staging's Vertex pacer loaded first: 2 Vertex request starts (Live, TTS) 8.69 s apart, 0 from the staging runtime in the window, 0 active calls. The launcher's naive .env read logged 'VERTEX_MODEL_MAP ignored' (the VM line is single-quoted); an offline comparison with the running runtime's /proc environ showed identical resolved model maps and Vertex locations, so the clips came from the models staging calls use. QA per clip on the VM: ffprobe, size, ffmpeg ebur128 (integrated LUFS, true peak) and volumedetect, and one Azure Speech REST short-audio hi-IN request on the shipped file decoded to 16 kHz WAV; word/character error and the product's affirms_ai and names.repair on the transcripts offline (ops/asr_wer.py). Machine QA only: no human listened, no browser played the files

nodes.title: sarvam-india still shows 'No sample recorded yet': the renderer refused it on staging ('Sarvam isn't set up on this server'), because staging carries no Sarvam key by design. Whether to use a Sarvam key for one sample (Sarvam may train on call data unless opted out) is the integrator's or owner's call
nodes.closes_when: A Sarvam key is approved for this, python -m vpvoice.samples --stack sarvam-india renders on the VM, and the clip passes the same QA (duration, loudness, format and size, Azure Speech round-trip with the disclosure and the name heard)

nodes.title: The renderer wrote spokenText '' for v2-live, although the audio is the whole line (Azure Speech word error 0/17). speak_live stops reading at turnComplete and breaks on any non-text frame, where the runtime's s2s read loop continues; inference, not diagnosed: Live's outputTranscription arrives after the renderer stops reading. An empty spokenText reads as 'said nothing', and decision.2026-10-24.voice-stack-sample-renderer's reverse_if keys on spokenText. Web ignores spokenText, so the card is right
nodes.closes_when: speak_live collects Live's outputTranscription (reads on past turnComplete for it, continues past non-text frames) or omits spokenText when it is empty, and a re-render of v2-live on the VM shows Live's own transcript
